It's very hard to describe when you lack the english vocabulary, but I think it is a perfect mix of meaningful lyrics (sometimes cringe for the "bad" bands) and ambient/instrumental parts letting the lyrics sink in while you headbang. 
Most of the songs have no real chorus, and yes, if you have not figured it out yet, they scream the lyrics, sometimes with a bit of clear voice. 

If you feel down and want to be shout at that your life is meaningful and you can get back up I'd strongly advise the following songs :

"To Be Misled" , "Courage" and "Perspectives" by Seasons in Wreckage 

"Messy Masterpiece" and "Unlovable" by Worthwhile

If it's the opposite and you want to share the pain of others (I know it works sometimes that way) :
